title: Seattle: Mt. Rainier, Private Tour (catered lunch)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
What you get with this private tour that others don't provide:
A catered lunch (deli sandwich and salad)
The refreshing spots of Mt. Rainier
Avoid the crowded areas
Snacks, quality chocolate bars. 

Great for corporate, business groups, and families!

A comfortable and pleasant experience.

Stops include:
Multiple viewpoints and photo spots
Old Growth Forest
Pristine alpine lake
Reflection Lakes
Multiple rest stops

About Max Travels:
Max Travels was created for people like you that want to experience the great nature of this area in a fun and friendly way.

My background includes travel support and research at businesses, executives, and tech companies.

We know about Seattle's layered history, the 90s Seattle music scene. Happy to help with tips on food, bakeries, chocolate, and other Seattle stuff.

We love nature, finding new places, and talking about travel. We look forward to talking with you on the tour!
